2608.09873.title: Sci-VBench: Evaluating Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation in Science Domains
2608.09873.paper_summary: We introduce Sci-VBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video generation across scientific domains. It contains 1,253 expert-annotated examples spanning 60 subjects across four core disciplines: Natural Science, Healthcare, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Engineering. Each example requires models to generate temporally rich videos that demand scientific reasoning and knowledge-grounded synthesis, going beyond surface-level visual plausibility. We further establish a rubric-based evaluation protocol. Our analysis shows that, under this protocol, both non-expert human evaluators and MLLM-as-Judge systems can achieve relatively high agreement with expert judgments, supporting reproducible evaluation at scale. We benchmark 16 frontier proprietary and open-source models and find that, while automatic perceptual-quality scores cluster tightly across systems, performance on Prompt Grounding and Scientific and Causal Correctness varies substantially, with a pronounced proprietary-open-source gap. These findings show that advances in visual realism have not yet translated into reliable modeling of scientific and causal dynamics.
2608.09873.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了 Sci-VBench，這是一個全面的基準，用於評估科學領域中知識和推理密集型的視頻生成。它包含 1,253 個專家標註的例子，涵蓋四個核心學科的 60 個主題：自然科學、醫療保健、人文與社會科學以及工程。每個例子都要求模型生成時間豐富的視頻，這些視頻需要科學推理和基於知識的綜合，超越表面層的視覺可信度。我們進一步建立了一個基於評分標準的評估協議。我們的分析顯示，在這一協議下，非專家的人類評估者和 MLLM-as-Judge 系統都能與專家評判達成相對較高的一致性，支持可重複的規模化評估。我們對 16 個前沿專有和開源模型進行了基準測試，發現雖然自動感知質量分數在系統之間緊密聚集，但在提示基礎和科學及因果正確性上的表現差異很大，顯示出明顯的專有與開源之間的差距。這些發現表明，視覺現實主義的進步尚未轉化為對科學和因果動力學的可靠建模。
